decisive_items: Lesion located in dorsolateral right pons
response.rationale: Facial nerve schwannoma best fits the pontine lesion with facial nerve dysfunction and imaging characteristics; multiple sclerosis is less typical given intermediate T2 signal and progressive course.

rejected.why: Neuroma location not consistent with intra-pontine lesion
No DWI hyperintensity and no vertebrobasilar occlusion argue against stroke
Peripheral facial palsy is a symptom description, not an etiologic diagnosis with this MRI finding
MS less likely due to intermediate T2 signal, older age, and progressive course
